name: @open-edu/pipeline
description: AI-driven content generation pipeline that transforms PDF textbooks into course-spec.md files

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/chunk/prompts dist/generate-concept/prompts dist/source dist/concepts dist/blueprint dist/validation && cp src/chunk/prompts/*.txt dist/chunk/prompts/ && cp src/generate-concept/prompts/*.txt dist/generate-concept/prompts/ && cp src/source/inventory-prompt.ts dist/source/ 2>/dev/null; cp src/concepts/prompt.ts dist/concepts/ 2>/dev/null; cp src/blueprint/prompt.ts dist/blueprint/ 2>/dev/null
